I told Marcus in his thread in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel since has changed it. Marcus is a member there, and a renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share.

One odd thing: there's a second message from me in #north-team right after my reply to Ilse on 14 October. It's in the main channel rather than her thread, and it's the summary I wrote about that reply. It doesn't share anything sensitive, but it's clutter you might want to delete.
